title: CanvasItem.draw_mesh breaks 2d batching
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in 4.6.1,  4.7.dev2

### System information

macOS 15.7.4

### Issue description

Experimenting a little with drawing simple 2D meshes I think I've found a bug in the 2d batching. When drawing multiple primitives using the same texture/color etc I'd expect them to be batched into a single draw call for performance. 

For example:
```
func _draw() -> void:
	for i:int in 10:
		draw_rect(Rect2(100+i*rect_size, 100+i*rect_size,rect_size,rect_size),Color.BLUE,true)
```
Works as expected, resulting in only 1 draw call.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/eb4f8510-9008-43d5-86f8-d46415a06889)

However, setting up a very simple two-triangle mesh square and rendering that in the same way:

```
func _draw() -> void:
	for i:int in 10:
		draw_mesh(mesh, null, Transform2D.IDENTITY.translated(Vector2(100+i*rect_size, 100+i*rect_size)), Color.RED)
```

Results in 10 draw calls.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/51b64df8-e8cc-4c32-995c-0ba9b97bacb6)

I would have expected this to also be batched into a single draw call, and that drawing a mesh would be more efficient than using the primitive shape draw_* calls, but instead this lack of batching seems to make it less performant?

The issue is the same in Compatibility renderer and Mobile as far as I can tell.

### Steps to reproduce

Create a simple array mesh, for example:

```
var mesh:ArrayMesh
var rect_size:float = 20

func _ready() -> void:
	#setup a simple mesh
	var verts:Array[Vector3]
	verts.append(Vector3(0,0,0))
	verts.append(Vector3(rect_size,0,0))
	verts.append(Vector3(rect_size,rect_size,0))
	verts.append(Vector3(0,0,0))
	verts.append(Vector3(rect_size,rect_size,0))
	verts.append(Vector3(0,rect_size,0))
	var surface_array = []
	surface_array.resize(Mesh.ARRAY_MAX)
	surface_array[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX] = PackedVector3Array(verts)
	mesh = ArrayMesh.new()
	mesh.add_surface_from_arrays(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES, surface_array)
```

Then draw mesh this 10 times in the canvasItem _draw func:

```
func _draw() -> void:
	for i:int in 10:
		draw_mesh(mesh, null, Transform2D.IDENTITY.translated(Vector2(100+i*rect_size, 100+i*rect_size)), Color.RED)
```

See that this results in 10 draw calls in the visual profiler.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[2d_draw_mesh_batching.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25893777/2d_draw_mesh_batching.zip)
